paper_id: Li et al. - 2012 - Observation vs statistics Near optimal online channel access in cognitive radio networks
title: Observation vs Statistics: Near Optimal Online Channel Access in Cognitive Radio Networks
motivation: 现有OSP和MAB两种范式存在鸿沟,难以有效整合学习和利用过程
problem_framing: 将信道接入建模为时域上的观察与统计博弈问题,关注感知顺序和访问规则的联合优化
key_insight: 感知顺序(sensing order)对在线信道接入策略设计至关重要,恰当的顺序可实现机会接入并降低计算开销
method_signature: CIE学习策略和OSP-in-MAB解耦算法,复杂度从O(KNK̄)降至O(K)
evaluation_criteria: 累积吞吐量 regret;与genie最优策略对比的相对增益
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: OSP in MAB将联合优化解耦为两阶段分别求解,难以证明其最优性,且性能略有损失
evidence_for_taste: sensing order indeed plays important role
It is hard to prove the optimality of the approach
the OSP in MAB policy is a compromised approach
the regret of myopic policy is approximately linearly increased
the myopic algorithm may not always converge to the optimal solution
thinking_moves: 将联合优化问题解耦降维换取计算可行性
通过仿真而非理论证明来验证次优方案的合理性
承认简化假设下最优性不可证,转而强调工程折中价值
extraction_notes: 论文提供了完整的算法描述、复杂度分析和仿真验证,证据充分
